articles.summary: Customer engagement platform recognized for ability to orchestrate connected, AI-driven customer experiences The next phase of customer experience hinges on how well brands turn customer data into relevant communications, real-time action, and responsible, proven AI use. CSG ® and Netcracker Technology today announced that CSG has been named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Customer Journey Orchestration Platforms, Q3 2026 , with the highest possible scores in 19 of 23 Forrester Wave™ criteria. CSG Xponent , a best-in-class customer engagement platform, helps brands land timelier, more relevant communications that drive customer action, secure loyalty, and bolster measurable business results.
